title: cache switch comparison and zero stale/unauthorized retrieval-cache hits

environment.profile: dev-stub (ORCHARA_PROFILE=dev-stub; no vendor credentials or endpoint)
environment.database: isolated PostgreSQL 16.4 at 127.0.0.1:55432; one throwaway database per test, migrated by the compiled cmd/admin chain
environment.api: compiled cmd/api behind real HTTP with the real filesystem object store, HMAC-signed links and the internal mTLS listener
environment.maintenance: compiled cmd/maintenance (document_ingest + artifact_finalize pools) as a real OS process
environment.embedding: local-hash-v1 in-process hash embedding (no vendor provider)
environment.cache: PostgreSQL platform.knowledge_retrieval_cache (ADR 0015; no Redis adapter in this build)
environment.resource_profile: one Windows host, PostgreSQL 16.4 on localhost, fixed 8-document corpus and 24-spec query sequence; cache-on and cache-off real API processes share the database/object directory and are sampled paired inside one measurement window
environment.toolchain: Python 3.12.2, Go 1.27.3, Node v24.13.0 (page script execution only)

commands: go build ./... ; go vet ./... ; go test ./...

fixed.order: cold phase then repeat phase, paired cache-on/cache-off per spec

cost.cost_is_zero_because: the retrieval endpoint embeds with the in-process local-hash-v1 hash and calls no model or vendor provider; the answer endpoint (not part of this comparison) uses the labelled extractive stub. 0 is the accounted cost, not an omission.
cost.real_model_cost: blocked (no vendor credentials/endpoint/adapter on this host)

correctness.note: exact JSON equality of items/next_cursor/acl_epoch/index, asserted per spec

inputs.query: 退款政策需要几天内申请

entries.per_resource_grant: not available in this build: policy.ResourceTypes is {application}; a knowledge-base/document grant/revoke entry does not exist (recorded as not_applicable with that code fact)

not_applicable: per-knowledge-base grant revoke: the F01 grant vocabulary is {application} only

sections.product_gap_found_and_fixed: the hit-time re-check compared the stored body sha256 with the artifact row only; it did not read the sealed object. A missing/replaced object was therefore served from the memoized text while the authoritative path skipped that candidate. The fix re-reads each sealed body on a hit and requires the exact stored text and sha256 (internal/knowledge/cache_store.go:cachedBodyMatches).

observed.concurrent_delete: covered by the deletion section: a query storm during the final DELETE produced zero post-commit hits and zero post-commit items

blocked.reason: no credentials/endpoint/adapter on this host (the same T055 boundary)
blocked.unblock: provide a vendor embedding adapter and credentials, then re-run the comparison
blocked.effect: the absolute latency/cost numbers are local-hash numbers, not vendor numbers

blocked.reason: no model provider exists; the answer path is the labelled extractive stub
blocked.unblock: provide a model provider; the answer cache question is answered structurally (the answer is regenerated every request and never stored)

not_run.item: SSE user path for the knowledge cache
not_run.reason: the knowledge retrieval/answer surface has no SSE endpoint; run-event SSE is a different surface and does not exercise the retrieval cache
no Playwright/Chromium on this host; the committed page script is executed under Node to prove it sends the same REST retrieval body
T114 owns the exclusive capacity window; this ticket measures one fixed corpus against two real API processes
this build has no Redis adapter; ADR 0015 stores the cache in PostgreSQL
